plan.title: RFQ auto title for family products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add two closest-available product rows using the supplied product fragment; this approximates the two same-family products but cannot guarantee they are distinct.
Set the first product row's location, triggering the title inputs.
Set the second product row's location and trigger the final automatic title update.
